headline: Municipal Social Services Staff
summary: Social services staff with four years in local government social programs in Pampanga. I explain program rules and eligibility to residents in plain language, keep case and beneficiary records, and help the office handle public records and policy updates. I work mainly with senior citizens, persons with disability and solo parents.
skills: Explaining social welfare laws and eligibility to residents
Talking with seniors, PWDs and solo parents

experience.title: Social Services Staff
experience.employer: San Fernando Pampanga Social Assistance Council
bullets: Process ID and benefit applications for senior citizens, persons with disability and solo parents.
Explain the rules of each program at barangay orientations and at the help desk.
Maintain case and beneficiary records and the office's public records archive.
Help draft updates to local social welfare guidelines after new national laws took effect.
